FAQ

Quick answers.

Games, Explorer and download.

Is KOVA free?

Yes. KOVA is free to download for Windows.

Which games does it support?

Universal support for Roblox games, with extra features for Bloxstrike and Fallen Survival.

What does External Explorer do?

Browse game objects and inspect their properties. The decompiler displays Lua reconstructed from scripts available to the client, alongside bytecode.

Where do I get updates?

Join the KOVA Discord for updates and community discussions.
